objective: Verify by executable diff that the final compute_pay and render_payslip implementations match the frozen C1 and C2 specs, and create tests/test_contract_shape.py asserting the exact interface shapes (return keys, tuple types, name-sorted list, 2-decimal summary pattern).

concepts: C1 spec: compute_pay returns exactly {gross: float, deductions: list, net: float}; deductions is a list of (str, float) 2-tuples sorted by name ascending
C2 spec: render_payslip returns list[str] whose last element matches the 2-decimal summary pattern
contract_consistency kind: read-only diff of implementations against frozen specs; no behavior changes

inputs: checkpoints/T01.json and checkpoints/T02.json (verified facts and changed paths)

allowed_dependencies.what: the final compute_pay implementation to diff against C1
the final render_payslip implementation to diff against C2

non_goals: Do not modify payroll/calc.py or payroll/payslip.py — this is a read-only diff; a mismatch is recorded, not patched
Do not change any production behavior or add a production code path
Do not modify the pre-existing tests in tests/test_payroll.py or any other task's test file
implementation_constraints: Read-only on all production code; the only deliverable is the shape test file
Shape checks must be exact: key-set equality, (str, float) tuple types, name-sorted assertion, and the summary regex '^Summary: net=\d+\.\d{2} gross=\d+\.\d{2} deductions=\d+\.\d{2}$'

deliverables.what: contract-shape tests asserting C1/C2 conformance of the final implementations

acceptance_tests.description: The shape test asserts compute_pay returns exactly the keys {gross, deductions, net}, with deductions a list of (str, float) 2-tuples sorted by name ascending, and all tests pass
acceptance_tests.evidence: the shape test runs via python -m unittest tests.test_contract_shape -v; the test asserts key-set and tuple-type conformance and exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: The shape test asserts render_payslip returns a list of str whose last element matches the 2-decimal summary regex, and the test passes
acceptance_tests.evidence: the shape test runs via python -m unittest tests.test_contract_shape -v; the test asserts the last element matches the 2-decimal summary regex and exits 0

acceptance_tests.description: If C1 or C2 is violated (extra return key, non-tuple entry, unsorted list, 1-decimal summary line), the shape test fails with the assertion diff and this task records the mismatch instead of patching the module
acceptance_tests.evidence: an intentionally broken variant (e.g. removing the sort) fails the shape test with the observed list diff; recorded in checkpoints/T03.json

failure_cases.scenario: A mismatch between an implementation and its frozen spec is found
failure_cases.expected_behavior: Stop out-of-scope implementation: emit a CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST (wrong spec) or record the deviation in checkpoints/T03.json for the owning leaf's checkpoint; T04 (seam gate) holds the only integration-only fix rights

handoff.notes: T04's full-suite gate includes this file; the T03 -> T04 data edge exists so the suite content is complete before the final gate runs.
